GENUINE OUTLET TAXONOMY EXISTS BUT IS CURRENTLY EMPTY: /collections/outlet, /collections/dp-outlet and /collections/outlet-feature were all checked. dp-outlet's own collection description explicitly reads '*All sales final. No returns or exchanges. See Outlet Terms & Conditions for more details' -- genuine permanent-clearance/outlet language by the site's own taxonomy. However all three currently show ZERO live products: /collections/<handle>/products.json returns an empty product array for all three despite the collections.json metadata reporting stale nonzero products_count values (outlet=2811, dp-outlet=outlet-feature=4047 -- outlet-feature and dp-outlet share the identical count, consistent with being the same underlying listing under two handles). Confirmed with a headless-browser render of both /collections/outlet and /collections/dp-outlet: both display 'No results. Use fewer filters or clear all.' to a live visitor. Also checked /collections/inventory-sale ('Inventory Sale', products_count=1 but products.json also empty -- same 0-live-products pattern) and /collections/sale-trending (products_count=0). Per the brief's drop-zero-product-listing rule, none of these five pages are emitted as rows, but the Outlet/Clearance concept genuinely exists in this site's taxonomy and would warrant a re-check if the catalog changes. EXCLUDED AS INTERNAL/BACKEND (not customer PLPs): /collections/promotional-sales, /collections/not-on-sale, /collections/2026-discount-eligible, /collections/discount-eligible-yes-copy -- the '2026-discount-eligible' collection's own description literally states 'This is an update to the Power Tools app Smarter Collections: Fullprice: Discount / Sale Eligible *Eligible for Discount', confirming these are automated merchandising-app utility collections used to drive discount-rule logic, not pages a shopper browses. No genuine, currently-populated Clearance/Outlet PLP exists on this site right now -- a real, checked absence, not a search failure.
